semantic_open.note: work_date/start_time/end_time and datetime params are naive Europe/Madrid wall-clock values computed in Go (time.Now().In(boMadridTZ)); DB stores them naive. MySQL TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE) on CONCAT(date,' ',time) and PG naive (date+time) subtraction both ignore DST (a shift spanning a DST change differs by +-60 real minutes on both engines identically). Not converted to UTC/timestamptz.

TIMESTAMPDIFF truncation toward zero -> trunc(EXTRACT(EPOCH ...)/60). MySQL GREATEST(0,NULL)=NULL (start_time NULL -> NOT NULL violation, strict error) preserved via CASE in a correlated subselect (PG GREATEST ignores NULLs). Entry patch '? IS NULL' typed CAST(? AS text).

RowsAffected==0 -> 404 'Miembro no encontrado'. MySQL CHANGED rows: identical re-save of an existing member returns 404 (source quirk). PG keeps it via ROW(8 cols COLLATE "C") IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(params). Not fixed.

ON CONFLICT (restaurant_member_id) - uniq_member_contracts_member, only collidable key (not tenant-scoped, as source). weekly_hours float64 -> numeric(6,2) rounding QA pending (float->decimal family).

MySQL decimal division with div_precision_increment 4 reproduced per division: minutes/60 ROUND 4, gross/monthly_hours ROUND 6 (2+4), pct/100 ROUND 6. Final sum scanned float64. Rounding mode half-up vs PG half-away identical for non-negative values; negative minutes would differ (not constrained by schema) - OPEN QA.

HOUR(opened_at) of naive UTC pos_tickets.opened_at -> EXTRACT(HOUR) (UTC hour, as source - not Madrid). 5-minute bucket = hour + floor(minute/5)*5 (equal to FLOOR(TIME_TO_SEC/300)*300). GROUP BY 1; no ORDER BY on either (unspecified row order, consumer sorts / maps). NULL start_time hour group scans into string and errors on both.
listBOActiveEntries/listBOTimeEntriesByMemberAndDate: e.start_time nullable ASC -> NULLS FIRST (MySQL order). Name ordering CI collation pending.
Clock start = read active entry then INSERT, no lock/unique key on both engines (double-start race unchanged). Stop UPDATE by id has no end_time IS NULL guard (source).
PG CONCAT treats NULL as '' while MySQL returns NULL; every CONCAT here is over NOT NULL columns or COALESCE'd -> unreachable difference.

semantic_open.note: Unchanged: remains cutover-blocking; no sanitizing implemented. Static grounding attempt: MySQL behaviour for invalid utf8mb4 under INSERT IGNORE is not documented in this repo; needs read-only source evidence/coordinator decision.

PG aborts the whole transaction after any statement error; InnoDB rolls back only the failed statement. Wrapped in a SAVEPOINT only where the source deliberately continues after an error: bo_users INSERT duplicate -> retry SELECT; ignored username UPDATEs (x2); ignored token-invalidation UPDATEs after onboarding password / reset confirm (x2). MySQL path unchanged. Adds 3 helper-internal statements (excluded from the canonical count: 5 -> 8). SYSTEMIC OPEN: earlier ported domains were not audited for 'error swallowed then same tx continues' - needs a repo-wide review before cutover.

With the savepoint, PG READ COMMITTED retry SELECT can see a concurrently committed user; MySQL REPEATABLE READ snapshot (already established by earlier reads in the tx) would not -> race case: MySQL returns the error, PG reuses the user. Non-race behaviour identical. OPEN isolation delta (code review only).

expiresAt is time.Now().Add(ttl) (process-local zone). MySQL driver (loc=UTC) stores the UTC wall clock; pgx would store the local wall clock -> bound via sqldb.NaiveUTCArg (t.UTC()) on PG. Fractional seconds: both engines round into timestamp(0); exact .5s tie rounding (MySQL half-up vs PG rint) unverified.

used_at/invalidated_at = NOW() and expires_at > NOW() on naive UTC timestamp(0) -> date_trunc('second',statement_timestamp()) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'. Single-use claim UPDATE ... used_at IS NULL: NULL->value always changes, RowsAffected gate identical; concurrent confirm: loser re-checks the committed row on both engines (InnoDB locking read / PG READ COMMITTED) -> 0 rows. Code review only. Raw tokens never read; token_sha256 equality under ci_ai (hex, harmless).

SOURCE QUIRK preserved: TIMESTAMP(work_date,start_time) is the Madrid wall clock while now/end time.Time are bound as the UTC wall clock (MySQL driver loc=UTC), so the window is offset by the UTC offset (1h/2h DST). PG binds NaiveUTCArg -> same comparison. Not fixed.
